title: REMAX Ranked No. 1 Real Estate Franchise Brand in 2026 Franchise Times Top 400
summary: For the 18th consecutive year, REMAX earned the highest ranking among real estate franchise brands on the annual list of the largest U.S.-based franchisors.
body_markdown:
Nobody in the world sells more real estate than REMAX, as measured by residential transaction sides. And for the 18th consecutive year, no real estate franchise brand ranked higher than REMAX on the[Franchise Times Top 400](https://www.franchisetimes.com/top-400-2026/) list.


In the 2026 rankings, REMAX secured the No. 1 position among real estate franchise brands and ranked No. 14 across all industries. The recognition places REMAX among an elite group of franchise organizations recognized for their size, performance and global business impact.


For nearly five decades, REMAX has built its reputation by helping entrepreneurs grow successful businesses through a globally recognized brand, industry-leading productivity and a trusted network of professionals. REMAX agents continue to earn recognition as the No. 1 most trusted real estate agents in the U.S.1 while operating within the world’s most productive real estate network.2


“REMAX continues to shine as the top-ranked franchise brand on this list for 18 years thanks in large part to the passion and entrepreneurial spirit of the brand’s franchisees and agent network,” says REMAX President Alex Vidal. “The REMAX brand and business model continue to attract the industry’s top professionals as they serve their local markets around the world.”


“The *Franchise Times* ranking reinforces what prospective franchise owners see in REMAX every day: a globally recognized brand backed by a proven business model, outstanding agent productivity and a support system designed to help entrepreneurs grow,” says Shawna Gilbert, Senior Vice President of REMAX Global. “The continued strength of the REMAX network gives franchise owners confidence that they’re investing in a brand built for long-term progress.”


The Franchise Times Top 400 is an annual ranking of the largest U.S.-based franchise systems based on global systemwide sales. The list recognizes franchise organizations that demonstrate significant scale, strong performance and sustained business success.


The ranking adds to a growing list of accolades earned by REMAX in 2026. Throughout the year, the brand and its franchise network have been recognized across the industry for agent productivity, brokerage performance, franchise excellence and leadership influence. Recent honors include recognition in RealTrends Verified[Best Brokerages](https://news.remax.com/remax-agents-average-twice-the-sales-as-competing-agents) and[City Rankings](https://news.remax.com/remax-agents-and-teams-stand-out-in-local-markets-according-to-2026-realtrends-verified-city-rankings) , Entrepreneur’s[Franchise 500](https://news.remax.com/remax-again-named-a-top-brand-in-franchise-500-keeping-streak-alive) and[Top 10 Franchises in Every Industry](https://news.remax.com/entrepreneur-ranks-remax-as-top-10-franchisor-in-services-category) rankings, as well as representation on the[Swanepoel Power 200](https://news.remax.com/remax-leaders-recognized-among-industrys-most-influential-on-swanepoel-power-200-list) list.


*1 Voted most trusted Real Estate Agency brand by American shoppers based on the BrandSpark® American Trust Study, years 2022-2025, and 2019.*


*2 As measured by residential transaction sides.*


Written by **REMAX News**
